nodes.label: libpq PQconnectdb
nodes.desc: Builds the connection string and performs the startup handshake.

nodes.label: PostmasterMain
nodes.desc: Binds the listen sockets and dispatches each new client to a backend.

nodes.label: exec_simple_query
nodes.desc: Runs the per-statement cycle of parse, plan, execute, and report.

nodes.label: pg_parse_query
nodes.desc: Hands the raw SQL text of the statement to the grammar layer.

nodes.label: raw_parser
nodes.desc: Scanner and grammar pair that produces raw parse trees.

nodes.label: transformTopLevelStmt
nodes.desc: Resolves names and types into a semantically valid Query tree.

nodes.label: QueryRewrite
nodes.desc: Expands views and applies rules and row-security policies.

nodes.label: standard_planner
nodes.desc: Entry point of cost-based planning, wrapped by plugin hooks.

nodes.label: make_one_rel
nodes.desc: Builds access paths for every relation mentioned in the query.

nodes.label: make_join_rel
nodes.desc: Enumerates join orders and methods, keeping the cheapest paths.

nodes.label: create_plan
nodes.desc: Converts the winning Path tree into executable Plan nodes.

nodes.label: ExecutorRun
nodes.desc: Starts and drives the plan, honoring direction and tuple count.

nodes.label: ExecProcNode dispatch
nodes.desc: Pulls one tuple at a time through the tree of plan nodes.

nodes.label: SeqNext
nodes.desc: Sequentially fetches the next heap tuple from the scan.

nodes.label: IndexNext
nodes.desc: Fetches heap tuples that match the index qualification.

nodes.label: ExecHashJoin
nodes.desc: Builds and probes in-memory hash tables for equi-joins.

nodes.label: ExecHashTableCreate
nodes.desc: Allocates and batches the shared hash table for joins and aggregation.

nodes.label: agg_fill_hash_table
nodes.desc: Feeds grouped input into hash or sorted aggregation strategies.

nodes.label: ExecSort
nodes.desc: Consumes the subplan and returns tuples in the requested order.

nodes.label: GetTransactionSnapshot
nodes.desc: Hands the executor the MVCC snapshot used for visibility decisions.

nodes.label: BufferAlloc
nodes.desc: Pins a page in shared memory, reading it from disk when needed.

nodes.label: BufTableLookup
nodes.desc: Shared hash table that maps page tags to buffer descriptors.

nodes.label: StrategyGetBuffer
nodes.desc: Clock-sweep scan that picks the next victim buffer.

nodes.label: heap_insert / heapgettup
nodes.desc: Writes new tuple versions and scans existing rows in the heap.

nodes.label: HeapTupleSatisfiesMVCC
nodes.desc: Decides whether a tuple version is visible to a given snapshot.

nodes.label: XLogInsert
nodes.desc: Assembles registered changes into one write-ahead log record.

nodes.label: CreateCheckPoint
nodes.desc: Writes checkpoint records so recovery knows where to start.

nodes.label: ApplyWalRecord
nodes.desc: Replays write-ahead records into pages during crash recovery.

nodes.label: TransactionIdSetStatusBit
nodes.desc: Records per-transaction commit or abort status in the CLOG.

nodes.label: CheckpointerMain
nodes.desc: Background process that performs checkpoints on demand or by timer.

nodes.label: AutoVacWorkerMain
nodes.desc: Launches workers that vacuum and analyze bloated tables.

nodes.label: heap_vacuum_rel
nodes.desc: Removes dead tuples from a table and reclaims their space.
